title: Share a helper
summary: Fastify: Share a helper. Call the helper with Asha.
introduction: decorate adds a named helper to the Fastify instance. GET / uses that helper.

blocks.text: In a practice folder run npm init -y and npm install fastify@5. Save one example as server.mjs and run node server.mjs. Use http://127.0.0.1:3000 and stop each server before the next example.

blocks.title: Share a helper

blocks.text: decorate adds greet to the app instance. The route calls it with Ravi.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Register the helper before the route uses it.
